b.name: Shipping Page Business Error Impact Analysis
b.business_goal: Quantify impact of errors on shipping.

g.name: Shipping Page Business Error Impact Analysis
g.intent: Quantify impact of errors on shipping.
g.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT identifiers_sessionid) AS total_error_sessions FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2 WHERE identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping' AND attr_error_type = 'warning + confirmation'

g.name: Checkout conversion by month
g.sql: SELECT date_format(CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT_IF(action = 'apptCompleted') AS completed FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com WHERE action = 'apptBooked' AND status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY 1

i.sql_skeleton: CASE WHEN next_action IS NULL AND label LIKE '%error%' THEN 'Technical Error' END
i.name: Last-Event Error Attribution
i.description: Categorizes exits as technical or business errors.
i.when_to_use: Analyzing why users abandon without navigating.

i.sql_skeleton: ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ts) AS rn
i.name: Row-number session index
i.when_to_use: Isolate the most recent event per session.
